title: Grateful Dead Live at William And Mary Hall - College Of William And Mary on 1973-09-12
venue: William And Mary Hall - College Of William And Mary

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with generally good sound despite a few glitches, highlighted by strong Bird Song, Weather Report Suite and an energetic Eyes of the World.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a solid mid‑1973 performance – the band delivers a soulful groove with standout moments like Bird Song, the Weather Report Suite and a jazzy, high‑energy Eyes of the World. The soundboard source is clear for the most part, though listeners note low‑volume mastering quirks and occasional audio glitches. Overall opinions are split: some find it pedestrian while others praise its groove and musicianship.

ai_rating.rationale: Eight detailed reviews show a balance of positive and negative comments; the musical performance is generally praised with several standout songs, while recording quality is good but marred by volume and glitch issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear soundboard capture, but low‑volume mastering gives a subdued feel; occasional audio problems and track‑labeling errors (e.g., Ramble On Rose mis‑tagged) are noted, as well as cuts in the second set.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as solid with good tempo and groove; second set appears short and partially cut, making the show feel less cohesive compared to the previous night.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for high‑energy guitar work, especially in Let It Grow (crazed rhythm) and new slide phrasing after Eyes jam.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for driving rhythm guitar alongside Jerry during Let It Grow; contributes to the Mingus‑like improvisational feel.
